title: Directional Coefficient Inequalities for Strongly Starlike Mappings in Complex Banach Spaces
summary: We study a class of strongly starlike mappings of order $α$ on the open unit ball of a complex Banach space under a scalar-profile condition. Using a slice reduction along one-dimensional complex subspaces, we prove a coefficient correspondence theorem identifying the directional coefficients with the Taylor coefficients of an associated one-variable strongly starlike function. We further prove a lifting theorem showing that every one-variable strongly starlike function can be realized by a scalar-profile Banach-space mapping.
